g.text: Sensitivity is slope; offset changes the intercept without changing slope

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Sensitivity units are output units divided by input units. For nonlinear sensors sensitivity varies with operating point. Greater slope can improve signal
size while also amplifying noise or limiting range; it does not itself establish accuracy or uncertainty.
